create_productionline.ponder.production_: Turn any recipe into a production line plan
Slot 1 takes the item to produce, slot 2 a blank Line Scheme
Slot 3 may hold paper: it stays readable as a manual after the scheme is loaded
Press Compute: the server derives it from its live recipes and writes the scheme
The scheme names the product, the base and the whole chain; a self-referencing recipe is marked incremental
Put the written scheme into any slot of a Scheme Loader
It takes effect at once: only the recipes refresh, the server does not reload
The bar on its side shows how much of it is in use
While recipes are active the cabinet emits a redstone signal
Build the line it describes: base onto the belt first, one Deployer per added material facing down
Dismantling what you do not need
The left slot takes a finished product, or an unfinished intermediate
Dismantling hands the materials back and leaves a read-only mirror
Dismantling a written scheme leaves a mirror and hands back a blank one
An unfinished intermediate gives back only what has been assembled so far
